turns.question: On which day of the week were the most orders placed between 17 August and 27 September 2026, and how many orders were placed on that weekday in total?
turns.answer: No single weekday led: from 17 August to 27 September 2026 every day of the week, Monday through Sunday, had the same 24 orders (Orders, cancelled included), so all seven weekdays tie for the most. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
